en: what it means or at what extent, but let me tell you what.
zh: 这意味着什么，或者说到了什么程度，但让我告诉你。

speaker: Unknown
en: So when we worked, when I lived with my mom, me and my sister were just talking about this the other day.
zh: 我们工作的时候，我住在我妈家的时候，前几天我和我妹妹还在聊这件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: So my mom worked all the time or was at school and me and my sister were home alone all the time.
zh: 我妈一直在工作，或者在上学，我和我妹妹总是独自在家。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we had chores that we had to do.
zh: 但我们有必须做的家务。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, we were,
zh: 我是说，我们，

speaker: Unknown
en: mow the lawn, you know, cleaning the pool and trimming the bushes and all that.
zh: 割草，你知道的，清理泳池、修剪灌木之类的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I was like, let me tell you what, the day I make a dollar, I'm never doing this shit ever again.
zh: 我就说，让我告诉你，等我哪天赚到一块钱，我再也不干这种破事了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that's probably an important lesson she taught you.
zh: 所以这大概是教给你的一个重要教训。

speaker: Unknown
en: No doubt about it.
zh: 毫无疑问。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I, you know, I try to do this with my kids too.
zh: 而且我，你知道，我也试着这样对我的孩子。

speaker: Unknown
en: My kids have been great and done everything the right way.
zh: 我的孩子都很优秀，每件事都做得对。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I've told this story before, but my son Aiden, my youngest son, flies home from college one weekend and says, I don't want to stay in school.
zh: 我之前讲过这个故事，我儿子 Aiden,我最小的儿子，有个周末从大学飞回家说，我不想继续上学了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have an idea for this business that I want to do and whatever.
zh: 我有一个想做的生意的想法，什么的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, he lays it all out for me.
zh: 我说，他给我把一切都讲了一遍。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm like, this is a pretty good idea.
zh: 我就说，这是个挺不错的想法。

speaker: Unknown
en: I get it.
zh: 我懂了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I like it.
zh: 我喜欢。

speaker: Unknown
en: But you're not going to quit school.
zh: 但你不能退学。

speaker: Unknown
en: And just try to do this.
zh: 就这么去尝试做这件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: This won't chew up eight to 10 hours of your day.
zh: 这不会占掉你每天八到十个小时。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're going to go out and you're going to get a job and you're going to put out, you're going to go put in applications and you're going to try to get a job.
zh: 你要出去，你要找份工作，你要去……你要去递交申请，你要试着找一份工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because if I die tomorrow, that's what you're qualified to do.
zh: 因为如果我明天死了，那就是你具备资格去做的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he did it.
zh: 他照做了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he went and he worked at U-Haul.
zh: 他去 U-Haul 工作了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And, you know, you got to have those kind of jobs.
zh: 而且，你知道，你得经历那种工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: My son right now, my oldest, is getting his master's degree in Boston right now.
zh: 我儿子，我最大的那个，现在在波士顿读硕士。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when I lived in Boston, I used to work for EJ Paving Company.
zh: 我住在波士顿的时候，曾在 EJ Paving Company 工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: They pave roads.
zh: 他们铺路。

speaker: Unknown
en: I actually want my son to go do some days at this paving company.
zh: 我其实想让我的儿子去这家铺路公司干几天。

speaker: Unknown
en: What is it you're trying to teach him?
zh: 你想教他什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, what hard work really is.
zh: 嗯，真正的辛苦工作是什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: So people like I run around, I don't sleep much.
zh: 像我这样的人到处跑，我睡得不多。

speaker: Unknown
en: And everybody's like, oh, you work so hard.
zh: 所有人都说，哦，你工作那么辛苦。

speaker: Unknown
en: You work so hard.
zh: 你工作那么辛苦。

speaker: Unknown
en: No, no, no.
zh: 不，不，不。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll show you what hard work is.
zh: 我让你看看什么叫辛苦工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: Hard work is construction.
zh: 辛苦工作是建筑。

speaker: Unknown
en: Hard work is concrete.
zh: 就在这条街上。

speaker: Unknown
en: Right up the street here.
zh: 就在这条街上面。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't know how many days this summer were 115 degrees out.
zh: 我不知道今年夏天有多少天是 115 度的高温。

speaker: Unknown
en: 115 degrees out.

speaker: Unknown
en: These construction guys are out there working in 115 degree, like hard work, real work.
zh: 这些建筑工人就在 115 度的高温下干活，那才叫辛苦工作，真正的工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then in the winter, people don't realize this in Vegas, but it gets down into the 30s.
zh: 而冬天，拉斯维加斯的人意识不到这一点，但气温会降到 30 多度。

speaker: Unknown
en: These guys will be outside working when it's 30 degrees out.
zh: 这些人会在 30 度的天气里在外面干活。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, and hard physical labor every day.
zh: 所以，每天都是辛苦的体力劳动。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then you go home, you eat and you go to bed, you start, get up the next day and you go do it again.
zh: 然后你回家，吃饭，上床睡觉，第二天起来，又去干一遍。

speaker: Unknown
en: In your life to figure out what you want to do,
zh: 在你的人生中，要弄清楚你想做什么，

speaker: Unknown
en: You have to figure out what it is you don't want to do.
zh: 你必须先弄清楚你不想做什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have a bunch of quotes here that you've said.
zh: 我这里有一堆你说过的话。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you just want to look at the first one.
zh: 如果你想看第一个的话。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's no such thing as a day off.
zh: 没有休息日这回事。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's no such thing as a day off when you run your own business.
zh: 当你经营自己的生意时,没有休息日这回事。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, there's no birthdays.
zh: 你知道的,没有生日。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's no Christmas.
zh: 没有圣诞节。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's no Thanksgivings.
zh: 没有感恩节。

speaker: Unknown
en: Bad shit will happen every single day that you need to deal with.
zh: 每一天都会有糟糕的事情发生,需要你去处理。

speaker: Unknown
en: But when you like what you do,
zh: 但当你喜欢自己所做的事情时,

speaker: Unknown
en: It's fun.
zh: 那就很有趣。

speaker: Unknown
en: A lot of people, especially young people these days, want to be entrepreneurs.
zh: 很多人,尤其是现在的年轻人,想当创业者。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, I'd really like to work for myself and own my own business because I'd love to plan my schedule.
zh: 你知道,我真的很想为自己工作、拥有自己的生意,因为我喜欢自己安排日程。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're going the wrong way.
zh: 你走错方向了。

speaker: Unknown
en: What you need to do is find a nine to five job where you have weekends and holidays off.
zh: 你需要做的是找一份朝九晚五的工作,周末和假期都能休息。

speaker: Unknown
en: And, you know, that's your move.
zh: 你知道的,那才是你该走的路。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you're looking to start your own business because you want more time to yourself, you are picking the wrong thing to do.
zh: 如果你想创业是因为想要更多属于自己的时间,那你就是选错事了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I promise you that.
zh: 我向你保证。

speaker: Unknown
en: The key to becoming a good entrepreneur is you have to find solutions to problems.
zh: 成为一名好创业者的关键在于,你必须找到问题的解决方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every day.
zh: 每一天。

speaker: Unknown
en: The universe was trying to fuck with me the other day.
zh: 前几天,宇宙想要整我。

speaker: Unknown
en: I got out of bed.
zh: 我下了床。

speaker: Unknown
en: I had to be at a board meeting at nine o'clock, right?
zh: 我得在九点钟参加一个董事会会议,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: I go in, I gotta shave.
zh: 我进去,我得刮胡子。

speaker: Unknown
en: Both my razors died.
zh: 我的两个剃须刀都坏了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I use electric razors.
zh: 我用的是电动剃须刀。

speaker: Unknown
en: They both died.
zh: 两把都坏了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Get through that.
zh: 熬过这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: I get in the car and I'm driving and the sensor says, your back right tire is low.
zh: 我上了车正在开车,传感器说,你的右后胎胎压低。

speaker: Unknown
en: Stop the vehicle immediately.
zh: 立即停车。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, yeah, no, we're not fucking stopping.
zh: 我说,是的,不,我们他妈才不停。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're going.
zh: 我们继续走。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's just life, right?
zh: 这就是生活,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: When you get up and it's life standing there to kick you in the face and you got to get through all this shit.
zh: 当你起床,生活就站在那里要踢你的脸,而你必须熬过这一切糟心事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then you get to work and there's a laundry list of problems and things you got to deal with.
zh: 然后你到了公司,就有一大堆问题和事情等着你去处理。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this younger generation that think you can work from home.
zh: 而这年轻一代以为你可以在家工作,

speaker: Unknown
en: and build a successful business, it's impossible.
zh: 并建立一个成功的生意,这是不可能的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can't do it.
zh: 你做不到。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm in the office from 8.30 in the morning, and I don't leave the office till 7, 8, 9, 10 sometimes, still, to this day.
zh: 我早上八点半就在办公室,而且我经常到七点、八点、九点,有时候十点才离开办公室,直到今天依然如此。

speaker: Unknown
en: There are times when I go to work, and my schedule's planned out for the day, but
zh: 有时候我去上班,我一天的日程已经安排好了,但是

speaker: Unknown
en: people will pop in my office and we start talking about things.
zh: 人们会走进我的办公室,我们开始聊各种事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: And, you know, when you have people, a good group of people like I have at the UFC, and we get in a room and you start talking, things pop up that you would never expect.
zh: 而且,你知道的,当你拥有一群像我 UFC 里这样优秀的人,我们聚在一个房间里开始聊天,就会出现你完全意想不到的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: And things happen and a lot of good ideas come from everybody being at work.
zh: 事情就这样发生了,很多好点子都来自大家聚在办公室里。

speaker: Unknown
en: Has being kicked in the face by business over the last couple of decades changed you?
zh: 在过去几十年里被生意踢脸,这改变了你吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: Definitely.
zh: 当然。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't freak out the way that I used to.
zh: 我不再像以前那样慌乱了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've been through it all.
zh: 我什么都经历过了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Mm-hmm.
zh: 嗯哼。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm way more calm now.
zh: 而且我现在平静多了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I see this with a lot of guys.
zh: 我在很多家伙身上都看到这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: You become, uh,
zh: 你会变得,呃,

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't want to say you get weaker, but you do get weaker as you get older.
zh: 我不想说你变得更弱了,但你确实会随着年龄增长变得更弱。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a softer side to you than you had when you were in the early days of building your business.
zh: 你比早年在打拼事业的时候多了一面更柔和的一面。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I don't ever want to be that guy.
zh: 而我永远不想成为那种人。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know what I mean?
zh: 你懂我的意思吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: I try not to be that guy, but you do relax and chill out and you don't.
zh: 我尽量不做那种人,但你确实会放松、会平和下来,而你不会……

speaker: Unknown
en: The things that you used to flip out about when you were younger, you don't when you're older.
zh: 年轻时候会让你抓狂的那些事,年纪大了就不会了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, I went through a phase where I ripped through like 10 secretaries in two years and
zh: 我是说,我经历过一个阶段,两年里换了大概 10 个秘书,

speaker: Unknown
en: Like I need people around me that can keep up.
zh: 因为像是我需要周围能跟得上我的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: You got to have people that can keep up and can handle...
zh: 你得有能跟得上、能应付……

speaker: Unknown
en: handle the load of work.
zh: 应付工作负荷的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, it's probably the busiest year for me this year because I have Zufa Boxing, Power Slap, and the UFC that I'm running these three companies.
zh: 你知道,今年对我来说可能是最忙的一年,因为我有 Zufa Boxing、Power Slap 和 UFC,我在经营这三家公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then there's a ton of other things that I do too.
zh: 然后还有一大堆其他我做的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we'll be on the road.
zh: 所以我们会一直在路上。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, I think we just got off.
zh: 你知道,我想我们刚结束。

speaker: Unknown
en: The last two months, we were home for like four days.
zh: 过去两个月,我们在家大概只待了四天。

speaker: Unknown
en: In the last two months.
zh: 在过去两个月里。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then I get home and I don't stop.
zh: 然后我回到家也不会停下来。

speaker: Unknown
en: I just, I go out and I do things.
zh: 我就是会出去做各种事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: And, you know, these guys that are with me, they have to, they're with me and it's tough.
zh: 而且,你知道,跟我在一起的这些人,他们必须……他们跟着我,这很不容易。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nobody owes you anything.
zh: 没有人欠你任何东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, you know, we talked a little bit about my parents and whatever.
zh: 所以,你知道,我们聊了一点关于我父母的事什么的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I had this kid that I grew up with.
zh: 我有个从小一起长大的孩子。

speaker: Unknown
en: And, you know, we were 12, 13, 14 years old.
zh: 而且,你知道,我们那时候 12、13、14 岁。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I remember his dad had done really well.
zh: 我记得他爸爸混得很好。

speaker: Unknown
en: And, you know, they had a beautiful house, they had cars.
zh: 你知道,他们有一栋漂亮的房子,有车。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, he had all the shit that you would want growing up.
zh: 你知道,他拥有你成长过程中想要的所有那些好东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I remember him telling me one time his dad ran into hard times.
zh: 我记得他有一次告诉我,他爸爸遇到了困难时期。

speaker: Unknown
en: And his dad had put a million dollars away for him in an account.
zh: 他爸爸曾经给他存了 100 万美元在一个账户里。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then his father ran into hard times and his father took the money.
zh: 然后他爸爸遇到了困难时期,他爸爸把那笔钱拿走了。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's like, my father stole a million dollars from me.
zh: 他说,我爸爸从我这里偷了 100 万美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I remember thinking, are you out of your fucking mind?
zh: 我记得我当时想,你他妈疯了吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: The fact that your dad even thought of you that way, that he would put that money away from you is incredible.
zh: 你爸爸居然会那样想着你,会为你把那笔钱存起来,这已经不可思议了。

speaker: Unknown
en: But that was never your money.
zh: 但那从来就不是你的钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: You didn't earn that money.
zh: 你没有挣到那笔钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: That wasn't yours.
zh: 那不是你的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I remember thinking that way when I was 12, 13, 14, right?
zh: 我记得我 12、13、14 岁的时候就是这么想的,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm like, that is definitely the wrong type of mentality.
zh: 我就想,那绝对是错误的心态。

speaker: Unknown
en: Entitlement.
zh: 理所当然的心态。

speaker: Unknown
en: Brutal.
zh: 很糟糕。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that guy grew up exactly the way you would expect that guy to grow up.
zh: 而那个人后来的成长,完全就是你预料到的那种成长方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's just, you know, nobody owes you anything.
zh: 他就是,你知道,没有人欠你任何东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nobody.
zh: 没有人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Listen, to be set up in a position where somebody can make some phone calls for you and do some things, but then once they do that, you have to go in and deliver.
zh: 听着,能处于一个有人可以为你打几个电话、帮你做一些事情的位置是一回事,但一旦他们做到了,你就必须进去并且交付成果。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's going to be a ton of people listening that want to be entrepreneurs.
zh: 会有很多人在听,他们想成为创业者。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you think most people are cut out for it?
zh: 你觉得大多数人都适合干这个吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: No.
zh: 不。

speaker: Unknown
en: No.
zh: 不。

speaker: Unknown
en: To be an entrepreneur is a very unique thing.
zh: 成为创业者是一件非常独特的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, it's hard enough for a lot of people to get up every day and depend on themselves to take care of themselves.
zh: 我是说,对很多人来说,每天起床并依靠自己照顾好自己都已经够难了。

speaker: Unknown
en: When you're an entrepreneur, lots of people depend on you.
zh: 当你是创业者的时候,很多人依赖你。

speaker: Unknown
en: Lots of people feed their families.
zh: 很多人要靠这个养家糊口。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I take that role very serious.
zh: 我非常认真地对待这个角色。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, when I got into this business...
zh: 我是说,当我进入这个行业的时候……

speaker: Unknown
en: Not a lot of people believed in it.
zh: 没有太多人相信它。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's why we bought the UFC for $2 million, right?
zh: 这就是我们花 200 万美元买下 UFC 的原因,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's be honest here.
zh: 我们坦白说吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: The UFC was purchased for $2 million.
zh: UFC 是以 200 万美元被收购的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if the Lakers sold for $12.5 billion, then the UFC is worth $50 billion, okay?
zh: 如果湖人队以 125 亿美元出售,那 UFC 就值 500 亿美元,好吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: So the people who did believe in this and did, you know, when I was trying to hire production people,
zh: 所以那些确实相信这件事的人,你知道,当我试图雇用制作人员的时候,

speaker: Unknown
en: Production people don't want to live in Las Vegas, Nevada, especially 25 years ago.
zh: 制作人员不想住在内华达州拉斯维加斯,尤其是 25 年前。

speaker: Unknown
en: They want New York or L.A., right?
zh: 他们想要纽约或洛杉矶,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: I was trying to hire sponsorship people, New York and L.A.
zh: 我试图雇用赞助方面的人,纽约和洛杉矶。

speaker: Unknown
en: They don't want to live here.
zh: 他们不想住在这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then I had a group of people, Craig Borsari, who is my head of production, who is an absolute rock star, the best in the business.
zh: 然后我有了一群人,Craig Borsari,他是我的制作主管,是个绝对的摇滚明星,是行业内最顶尖的。

speaker: Unknown
en: He was a rising star at Fox.
zh: 他当时是 Fox 的后起之秀。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: He left Fox and came here because he believed in the vision and what was happening here.
zh: 他离开了 Fox 来到这里,因为他相信这里的愿景和这里正在发生的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: When you think back on that journey of buying it for $2 million, and then let's say it's worth $50 billion now if it was valued, you know, relevant to the Lakers.
zh: 当你回想那段历程——花 200 万美元买下它,然后假设现在按与湖人队相关的估值来算,它值 500 亿美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: If there were principles, if there were like a couple of principles that you would most attribute to the success of the UFC...
zh: 如果有一些原则,如果有那么几条你最能归因于 UFC 成功的原则……

speaker: Unknown
en: When at the time, nobody wanted to put on the fights anywhere.
